## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: An approval request records its resolved owner set, and a decision by a...

The system SHALL ensure that an approval request records its resolved owner set, and a decision by a principal outside it is rejected.

#### Scenario: An approval request records its resolved owner set, and a decision by a...

WHEN `owner-routed-escalation` is implemented
THEN An approval request records its resolved owner set, and a decision by a principal outside it is rejected.

### Requirement: An unresolvable owner fails closed to the repository-default owner and the...

The system SHALL ensure that an unresolvable owner fails closed to the repository-default owner and the fallback is reported.

#### Scenario: An unresolvable owner fails closed to the repository-default owner and the...

WHEN `owner-routed-escalation` is implemented
THEN An unresolvable owner fails closed to the repository-default owner and the fallback is reported.

### Requirement: An escalating queue agent parks the item in a resumable state and claims...

The system SHALL ensure that an escalating queue agent parks the item in a resumable state and claims another ready entry; the parked item becomes ready again within one reconciliation cycle of the owner's answer.

#### Scenario: An escalating queue agent parks the item in a resumable state and claims...

WHEN `owner-routed-escalation` is implemented
THEN An escalating queue agent parks the item in a resumable state and claims another ready entry; the parked item becomes ready again within one reconciliation cycle of the owner's answer.

### Requirement: A principal can list every open escalation addressed to them, with its item,...

The system SHALL ensure that a principal can list every open escalation addressed to them, with its item, options, recommendation, default action, and deadline.

#### Scenario: A principal can list every open escalation addressed to them, with its item,...

WHEN `owner-routed-escalation` is implemented
THEN A principal can list every open escalation addressed to them, with its item, options, recommendation, default action, and deadline.

### Requirement: In solo mode approvals route to the sole principal with no additional...

The system SHALL ensure that in solo mode approvals route to the sole principal with no additional prompts or gates compared to today.

#### Scenario: In solo mode approvals route to the sole principal with no additional...

WHEN `owner-routed-escalation` is implemented
THEN In solo mode approvals route to the sole principal with no additional prompts or gates compared to today.
